newsitem.title: USA: IHS terminates merger pact with Coram.
newsitem.headline: IHS terminates merger pact with Coram.

text.p: Coram Healthcare Corp said Monday it had received a letter from Integrated Health Services Inc terminating their merger agreement.
The merger pact was reached last October. It was amended late last month.

Coram said in a statement that "continuing requests by IHS to make changes to the original and amended merger terms eventually led Coram's board to believe that further negotiations were no longer in the best interests of Coram's shareholders or the company."
IHS officials were not available for comment.
